A data table. Parameter Type Required Description headers Sequence[str] ✅ Column header labels rows Sequence[Sequence[Any]] ✅ Row data arrays row_ids Sequence[str] — Stable unique ID per row. Makes rows selectable by click, Enter or Space actions Sequence[str] — Row action button labels (requires row_ids) With row_ids, the dashboard renderer emits bubbling DOM events from the table, so a custom view can own query state (search, filters, page, sort) and react to rows: Event detail aiui:table-select {rowId, index} aiui:table-action {action, rowId} Because events carry the stable rowId, selection stays correct after the server re-sorts or filters rows. Parameter Type Required Default Description total int ✅ — Total items page int ❌ 1 Current page (1-based) per_page int ❌ 10 Items per page id str ❌ None Identifier echoed in the page-change event The control is optimistic: clicking ←, →, or a page number updates the active page and dispatches a bubbling aiui:pagination DOM event. The dashboard.js renderer supports any dict with a type key. Unknown types render as formatted JSON, making it safe to experiment:
Understanding how components flow from Python to the browser.

Python: Call aiui.card("Revenue", value="$1,500") — returns a dict: Server: @aiui.page() handler returns aiui.layout([...]): API: GET /api/pages/{id}/data returns the JSON Frontend: dashboard.js detects _components key and calls renderComponents(): Renderer: renderComponent(comp) dispatches on comp.type: DOM: Each renderer creates HTML elements with db-* CSS classes
The magic key that triggers structured rendering: aiui.layout(children) automatically wraps children in {"_components": [...]}.
Every component function returns a dict with: Key Required Description type ✅ Component type name (e.g. "card", "table") Other keys Varies Component-specific properties

All components use db-* prefixed CSS classes: Component CSS Class Card .db-card, .db-card-title, .db-card-value, .db-card-footer Table .db-viewer table Alert .db-alert, .db-alert-info, .db-alert-success, etc. Badge .db-badge, .db-badge-secondary, .db-badge-destructive Tabs .db-tabs, .db-tab-list, .db-tab-btn, .db-tab-panel

To add a new component type: Python: Add function to ui.py: Frontend: Add renderer to dashboard.js: CSS: Add styles for .db-timeline Until the frontend renderer is added, unknown types render as formatted JSON.
